FX-MAGNIFY-001.says: The settings as they start: a circle of radius 100 round the middle, magnification 200, standard scaling, Normal: the whole picture enlarged twice round (8, 5), blocks of 2 by 2 pixels, laid over the drawing, which shows through only where the enlargement is clear or soft (After Effects' doubling).

FX-MAGNIFY-002.says: Magnification 100 with blending mode None: the area reads each pixel itself, so the drawing comes back untouched.

FX-MAGNIFY-003.says: Size 4: a circle of radius 4 round (8, 5) enlarged twice, the drawing round it.

FX-MAGNIFY-004.says: Size 4, square: the area a square 8 by 8 round (8, 5).

FX-MAGNIFY-005.says: Size 4, feather 2: the circle fades over the last 2 pixels inside its edge.

FX-MAGNIFY-006.says: Link size to magnification, size 2: the radius 200 per cent of 2, so FX-MAGNIFY-003 exactly.

FX-MAGNIFY-007.says: Link size and feather, size 2, feather 1: radius 4, feather 2, so FX-MAGNIFY-005 exactly.

FX-MAGNIFY-008.says: Size 4, opacity 50: the area at half its covering, over the drawing.

FX-MAGNIFY-009.says: Soft scaling: as FX-MAGNIFY-001 with each place read by document 21's bilinear sample, smooth instead of blocky.

FX-MAGNIFY-010.says: Scatter scaling: as FX-MAGNIFY-001 with each place nudged by up to a half a picture pixel each way (j = 1/2 at 200 per cent) by Noise's hash, so the blocks' edges break up.

FX-MAGNIFY-011.says: Size 4, blending mode None: the circle alone, clear round it.

FX-MAGNIFY-014.says: Size 5, Add, each straight colour held to 1.

FX-MAGNIFY-015.says: Size 5, Overlay, on the encoded colours.

FX-MAGNIFY-016.says: Size 5, Soft Light, on the encoded colours.

FX-MAGNIFY-017.says: Resize Layer on, size 4, centre at 90, 50 (14.4, 5), the layer moved 3 pixels left: the circle reaches 2.4 pixels past the right edge, so the layer grows 3 pixels on every side and the area shows past the drawing's edge, in columns 13 to 15.

FX-MAGNIFY-018.says: FX-MAGNIFY-017 with the link at size (size 2, so radius 4): After Effects turns Resize Layer off when linked, so nothing grows and the circle is cut at the drawing's edge.

FX-MAGNIFY-019.says: Magnification keyed from 100 at frame 0 to 400 at frame 4, size 4, linear: 175 at frame 1, 400 at frame 4.

FX-MAGNIFY-020.says: Centre keyed from 25, 50 at frame 0 to 75, 50 at frame 4, size 3: the lens slides across.

FX-MAGNIFY-021.says: Size 4 with the layer moved 3 pixels right: the same area, moved; columns 0 to 2 empty.

FX-MAGNIFY-022.says: Magnification 300, size 100: blocks of 3 by 3 pixels.

FX-MAGNIFY-023.says: Size eased from 4 at frame 0 to 0 at frame 4 on a curve that overshoots: at frame 2 it would pass below 0 and is held there, so frames 2 and 4 show no area, the drawing as it is.

FX-MAGNIFY-024.says: Magnification 99, below 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MAGNIFY-025.says: Magnification 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MAGNIFY-026.says: Size -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MAGNIFY-027.says: Feather 1001, above 1000. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MAGNIFY-028.says: Opacity 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MAGNIFY-029.says: Centre at 1001, 50, past ten widths. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MAGNIFY-030.says: Shape "oval". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MAGNIFY-031.says: Link "feather". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MAGNIFY-032.says: Scaling "bicubic". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-MAGNIFY-033.says: Blending mode "difference", which this build does not offer. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
